top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained I observed a caregiver pulling a child to the ground and holding in a restraint hold.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric first aid.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records- Kept at home and available for review (26 TAC §747.603(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One infant did not have records available at the time of the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Emergency preparedness plan was unavailable to review

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parents Review Licensing Rules and Reports (26 TAC §747.501(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Information how parents to review a copy of the child-care home's most recent Licensing inspection report was not observed in the operational policies.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies lacked information regarding parent rights.
